title: Move the JSON helpers out of the server
goal: Reading and writing JSON over HTTP lives in one module that new routes can reuse.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new module src/http.mjs exports send(res, status, body) and readJson(req); src/server.mjs imports them and no longer defines its own.
No behaviour changes: statuses, headers, bodies, the 64 KB body limit and the error answers stay exactly as they are; the existing tests pass unchanged.
src/http.mjs has unit tests of its own.

context.notes: High risk: every request goes through this code. Keep node:http only.
